Vyshnivets Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Ternopilska oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This is the older of Vyshnivets's two Jewish cemeteries, a companion to the New cemetery documented elsewhere in this collection. According to a US Commission expedition in the 2000s, its earliest preserved gravestone dates to 1583, suggesting the cemetery already operated in the late 16th century — making it older than the neighboring New cemetery's own earliest evidence. It served the same community whose Jewish self-defense group staved off violence during the Russian Civil War, and whose ghetto was liquidated on August 11, 1942, with about 2,500 people executed.
